emma_sales: Heads-up: AuroraPay POC warmup hitting 429 spikes during their 5min stress window. They go live with a demo in 30m, need an urgent swarm.
raj_se: Are they on Hosted sandbox or Dedicated? Any sample error payloads?

olivia_oncall: On it. Quick wins: 1) bump route burst for sandbox temporarily, 2) suggest client backoff, 3) offer fallback model. Can someone confirm route name?
emma_sales: Route is `aurora-gen`. I'll DM creds.
raj_se: Proposed route patch: `{"burst":500,"max_concurrency":40}`. Also limit `max_tokens` to 160 for POC.
infra-bot: route update queued for aurora-gen by olivia_oncall.
olivia_oncall: Applied route change. Also enabled burst-capacity for that sandbox group.
mike_prod: Watching runtime metrics: 429s drop from ~90/min to ~12/min after change. Latency steady at 220-260ms. KV lock rate improved.
tara_csm: Customer on call says responses look stable. They're happy to proceed. I'll log POC notes and prepare follow-up deep dive.
raj_se: Filing SUP-9133 with traces. Action items: 1) consider default sandbox limits update, 2) provide sales playbook snippet for temporary quota requests, 3) postmortem if regression.
emma_sales: Thanks all. Keep thread open until we confirm no further spikes in the next 15m. :thumbsup:
